verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists "BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments" as an offering, and the compliance docs refer to "all deployment options." That is a first-party claim of in-VPC deployment, but it rests on a pricing-page bullet with no deployment documentation behind it. missing for 10: deployment documentation for BYOC/Hybrid (architecture, which components run in the customer VPC, setup steps), evidence of a fully self-hosted or air-gapped option, confirmation that documents never leave customer infrastructure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure

citations.quote: Extend maintains enterprise-grade security controls across all deployment options.
